Synopsis:
A Philippine inter-island ferry caught fire Wednesday night while en route from Manila to Coron, Palawan, carrying over 130 passengers. As of Friday, 5 confirmed dead, 43 rescued, and 84 still missing. Burned remains were found in economy accommodation. Cause under investigation, with survivor accounts citing two successive explosions aboard. The incident highlights persistent maritime safety failures in the Philippine archipelago, following a separate sinking in January 2026 that killed 60+.
